svg.title: Monastery of Ashen Bells architectural plan and circulation
svg.desc: A surveyed plan, bell stair plan, and circulation flows for the native Monastery reconstruction.
svg.text: Two 1.80 m flights meeting at a 1.95 m deep landing
Both flights reach the north cloister.
A separate door leads to the chamber.
Roadhead → gatehouse → south cloister → herb court
West → north → east → south → west cloister
East cloister → tower → receiving court → refectory
North cloister → east stair → crypt → west stair → west cloister
Dashed routes show how to reach existing sills, floors and landings.
